Agentic - 1.pdf.title: Not Every AI That Uses Tools Is an Agent
Agentic - 1.pdf.summary: The difference between using a tool and working toward a goal with decisions and feedback.

Agentic - 2.pdf.title: Chatbot vs Workflow vs Agent
Agentic - 2.pdf.summary: Compare conversational responses, predefined workflows and agents that choose their next action.

Agentic - 3.pdf.title: Inside an AI Agent: Brain + Tools + Memory + Rules
Agentic - 3.pdf.summary: A visual introduction to the components that make an agent useful.

Agentic - 4.pdf.title: The Agent Loop: How an AI Agent Gets Things Done
Agentic - 4.pdf.summary: Follow an agent through decisions, actions and observations as it works toward a goal.

Agentic - 5.pdf.title: Not Every Problem Needs an AI Agent
Agentic - 5.pdf.summary: Consider when an agent helps and when a simpler approach fits the task.

Agentic - 6.pdf.title: How AI Agents Use Tools
Agentic - 6.pdf.summary: Explore how tools connect an agent to actions outside the language model.

Agentic - 7.pdf.title: How AI Agents Plan Their Next Move
Agentic - 7.pdf.summary: Explore ReAct, plan-and-execute and hybrid planning, with examples of replanning, progress tracking and stopping conditions.

Agentic - 8.pdf.title: How AI Agents Remember
Agentic - 8.pdf.summary: Understand working and long-term memory, then follow how agents store, retrieve, correct and delete information.

Agentic - 9.pdf.title: A Smart Agent Can Still Fail with the Wrong Context
Agentic - 9.pdf.summary: Learn how to gather, select and structure context while preserving source authority and boundaries around untrusted content.

Agentic - 10.pdf.title: Traditional RAG vs Agentic RAG
Agentic - 10.pdf.summary: Compare fixed retrieval pipelines with query decomposition, source routing and iterative evidence gathering.

Agentic - 11.pdf.title: Building a Capable Single Agent
Agentic - 11.pdf.summary: Design a focused agent with success criteria, useful tools, relevant context, working state and behavioral evaluation.

Agentic - 12 (1).pdf.title: When One AI Agent Becomes a Team
Agentic - 12 (1).pdf.summary: Explore specialist routing, handoffs, supervisors and parallel agents, including the costs of coordinating their work.

Agentic - 13.pdf.title: How AI Agents Do Deep Research
Agentic - 13.pdf.summary: Explains how agents plan research, explore and compare sources, verify evidence, and synthesize a cited report.

Agentic - 14.pdf.title: Can an AI Agent Check Its Own Work?
Agentic - 14.pdf.summary: Introduces reflection and evaluator-optimizer loops that use clear criteria, feedback, and verification to improve agent outputs.

Agentic - 15.pdf.title: How Does an AI Agent Work for Hours, Days… or Weeks?
Agentic - 15.pdf.summary: Explains how long-running agents preserve state, save checkpoints, and resume safely through interruptions and human approvals.

Agentic - 16.pdf.title: How Do AI Agents Connect to So Many Apps?
Agentic - 16.pdf.summary: Introduces MCP as a shared protocol for connecting AI applications to external tools and data through reusable clients and servers.

Agentic - 17.pdf.title: How Do AI Agents Talk to Each Other?
Agentic - 17.pdf.summary: Introduces A2A as a shared protocol for independent agents to discover capabilities, delegate tasks, communicate, and return results.

Agentic - 18.pdf.title: How Do AI Agents Show You the Right Interface?
Agentic - 18.pdf.summary: Explains how A2UI lets agents describe interactive interfaces that host applications render using their own components.

Agentic - 19.pdf.title: How Does a Frontend Keep Up with an Agent While It Works?
Agentic - 19.pdf.summary: Introduces AG-UI as the live communication layer for streaming agent events, synchronizing state, and exchanging tools and user input.

Agentic - 20.pdf.title: Why Can the Same Model Feel Like a Completely Different Agent?
Agentic - 20.pdf.summary: Explains how an agent harness combines tools, state, runtime controls and tracing to turn a model into an operating agent.

Agentic - 21.pdf.title: Your Agent Worked Once. Does That Mean It Works?
Agentic - 21.pdf.summary: Introduces agent evaluations that use task contracts, repeated trials, traces and graders to measure outcomes, safety and cost.

Agentic - 22.pdf.title: Why Does an Agent Forget Everything Next Time?
Agentic - 22.pdf.summary: Explains how short-term and long-term memory retain selected information and retrieve it into context for future work.

Agentic - 23.pdf.title: Should an Agent Plan Before It Acts?
Agentic - 23.pdf.summary: Shows when agents should plan, how to break goals into ordered actions, and when new evidence calls for replanning.

Agentic - 24.pdf.title: What Happens Between the Goal and the Action?
Agentic - 24.pdf.summary: Introduces ReAct, reflection and search as control loops for choosing actions, checking results and improving decisions.

Agentic - 25.pdf.title: Why Does Agent Security Matter?
Agentic - 25.pdf.summary: Examines prompt injection and tool-related risks, with trust boundaries, limited permissions, approvals and tracing to control agent actions.

GenAI - 15.pdf.summary: Explain how vector embeddings represent words and their meaning as numbers.

GenAI - 16.pdf.summary: Compare fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented generation as approaches to customizing an AI system.

GenAI - 17.pdf.title: Multimodal AI: AI That Sees, Hears & Understands!
